messages:
maria: Heads-up: we need a final benchmark narrative + two hero visuals for the "latency vs cost" webinar. Goal: make the tradeoffs instantly scannable for product leaders and infra buyers.

sam: Quick ask: can one visual be non-technical? PMs should get the point in 3-4s.

nina: I propose: Hero A = simplified 2-axis scatter (Latency on X, Cost on Y) with 3 model clusters and deploy tiers annotated. Hero B = a small multiples view showing cost per 1k tokens across 4 real workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings, search).

oscar: Love small multiples for storytelling. Also: annotate an example row like "chat at 200ms = $0.10/1k tokens" so numbers feel real.

tara: For messaging, steer away from model brand names on main visuals. Use Model X/Y/Z (open) and keep a "methodology" slide with exact model versions and quant configs.

eng-bot: benchmark-export: ready -> /eng-ml/benchmarks/176111/latency_cost_export.csv

maria: Perfect. Design note: make scatter tooltips show "typical latency distribution" (P50/P95) and a toggle for batching on/off.

sam: CTA routing: people clicking hero -> short form (company size, infra choice, estimated tokens/day). Send >1B tokens/day leads to SDR queue; others to self-serve nurture.

nina: I can write 3 headline variations for testing: 1) "See where models belong: cost vs latency" 2) "Pick the right tradeoff for your product" 3) "Lower latency or lower cost? Choose both smartly."

oscar: For socials: short punchy lines: "Same model, very different economics" and "Where should you run inference?" with link to interactive scatter.

tara: Interactive idea: let users filter by workload and compare hosted vs dedicated vs private. That will help platform teams. But for webinar deck keep interactive demo as a live route, not primary slide.

maria: Data call: eng please confirm numbers are median across 10 runs and include default batching. If not, label it.

eng-bot: confirm: medians across 10 runs; default batch = 8.

sam: Accessibility: avoid red/green pairs on scatter; use shapes + colorblind palette. Also add short alt copy for the landing page.

nina: Social test matrix: A/B headline + GIF of scatter zoom + CTA "Register" vs "Try interactive". Track conversion by infra preference field.

oscar: For the webinar script: start with a one-slide "what matters" (latency, cost, reliability), then the scatter, then a short demo of routing & cost delta, then a customer vignette.

tara: We should bake in a single-callout: "Switching to dedicated reduced per-token cost by X while latency improved by Y in our example app" — but use ranges and be explicit about variance.

maria: Action items: nina -> draft headlines + slide copy; oscar -> sample numeric callouts and slide notes; tara -> interactive spec + demo steps; sam -> social hook variants and form fields; i'll assemble a one-pager with visuals and distribution plan.

sam: I'll put the short-form for the MQL: company size, infra preference, tokens/day, contact email. Keep it 3 fields.

nina: Drafts coming in 2h.

oscar: I'll pull 3 representative app numbers for the slide (low, medium, high).

eng-bot: reminder: export file is in #eng-ml, ping to get access if needed.

maria: Deadline: mock visuals by end of day tomorrow, landing page copy + form by Thursday morning. Thanks team!

oscar: One more: competitor visuals note 1 — post any strong examples here.

sam: Will add a couple of screenshots of competitor one-pagers for reference.
